name: Burpee
instructions: Squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Jump or step your feet back into a high plank.
Lower your chest to the floor, then press back up (optional), and bring your feet back toward your hands.
Jump up explosively with arms overhead and repeat.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A full-body conditioning move that combines a squat, plank and jump into one fluid rep.

safetyNotes: Step instead of jump if your wrists, knees or back need a lower-impact option.
